ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2004; Terrorism Suppression Act 2002; International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008 and Beneficial Ownership Regulations); applicable Economic Substance Regulations 2019; and related directives of the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each ultimate beneficial owner's passport biometric page
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the UBO's citizenship; certified by a Samoa-licensed notary or registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for jurisdictions party to the Apostille Convention) or Consular Legalization (for non-party jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address of the UBO (recent utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or financial institution; notarized by a notary public in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization depending on country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate register extract or certificate of incumbency for any corporate shareholder held by the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar or registered agent in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Deed of undertaking / preliminary letter of acceptance from the proposed Samoa registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Samoa International Company registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original wet-ink or notarized copy; no apostille required if issued in Samoa

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners against the US OFAC SDN list, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions, UK HM Treasury sanctions, the European Union consolidated list, and Samoa's domestic terrorism listing under the Terrorism Suppression Act 2002. PEP status is assessed using a risk-based approach; enhanced due diligence is required for foreign PEPs, family members, and close associates. Screening must be completed before name reservation and repeated upon any change in ownership or directorship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry – International Companies Section, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), inclusive of the official online filing portal of MCIL
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Roman (Latin) characters; no statutory requirement to use the local Samoan language. A foreign-language name must be accompanied by a certified transliteration or English translation. The name must contain a statutory liability indicator such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', or 'Inc.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name in Samoa.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or licensed registered agent may, within 14 days of written notification, file a formal appeal with the Registrar of International Companies. The appeal must include a signed memorandum, a copy of the rejected name reservation receipt, evidence of any ministerial approval if the name contains a sensitive token, and payment of the prescribed appeal fee. The Registrar must issue a determination within 15 business days. An adverse determination may be escalated to the Companies Appeals Board and ultimately to the Supreme Court of Samoa by way of judicial review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for the webnovel platform's digital operations, but the International Company must maintain a registered office in Samoa at the physical address of a licensed registered agent. No local employment, premises, or physical business presence is required for the proposed low-risk offshore content platform, subject to compliance with applicable economic substance and AML/CFT obligations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection is approximately 2–5% for a 'Low_Risk_Standard' digital content business. Physical inspection, if any, is likely to focus on the registered agent's records and not on the company's remote operational premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended; incorporating provisions: ss. 6 (incorporation), 8 (Memorandum and Articles of Association), 10 (registered agent), 16 (share capital), 44 (directors), and 76 (company records).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form 1) submitted via a licensed registered agent, with the Registrar issuing the Certificate of Incorporation under seal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; share capital may be denominated in any permitted currency, subscriber shares may be issued at par, and no escrow or capitalization deposit applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the incorporator hereby adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Registrar of International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987 of Samoa. RESOLVED that the registered office be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and the agent be authorized to maintain statutory registers. RESOLVED that the subscription of one fully paid ordinary share by the founding member be approved and the corresponding share certificate be issued. RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed sole Director and [Name] be appointed Secretary, each to hold office under the Articles. RESOLVED that the Director be authorized to open corporate bank accounts, execute digital content distribution agreements, and complete all post-incorporation filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL (via licensed registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request accompanied by the proposed company name and a brief statement of purpose. Verify that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to any existing Samoa or foreign registered entity, and that it does not imply government sponsorship or a prohibited activity.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney to the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or undesirability, the applicant may file a fresh reservation with an alternative name within 5 business days or appeal to the Registrar with written submissions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL-licensed registered agent and registered office provider.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent services agreement. The agent must confirm acceptance of the appointment and allocate a registered office address in Samoa. The agent compiles the customer due diligence file, including beneficial ownership particulars, for retention by the agent and the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies and proof of address of incorporators and ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent declines the engagement due to insufficient due diligence documents, the applicant must promptly supplement the missing records; any delay is cured within 10 business days without prejudice to the filing timeline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and filing of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, including share capital structure (no minimum), classes of shares (ordinary single class), director and secretary provisions (minimum one director natural person; a corporate secretary may be appointed), and adopted clauses for exempt company status. The document is signed by the incorporator and witnessed, then submitted electronically or physically by the registered agent to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (signed and witnessed)
Consent of first director and first secretary
Notarized power of attorney (if foreign incorporator)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition or notice of defect, the registered agent has 14 days to respond by amending the constitutional documents or supplying clarifications; failure to cure leads to deemed withdrawal with refund of prescribed portion of fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of state filing fee and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation of the Memorandum and Articles, the official incorporation fee of approximately USD 200 must be paid via bank transfer to the Samoa Government consolidated revenue account or as directed by the Registrar. The Registrar then issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the incorporation date, company number, and seal.
required_dossiers: Proof of fee payment (SWIFT receipt or agent's payment confirmation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is misallocated or the certificate is delayed, the registered agent reconciles the payment through the MCIL finance unit; an expedited reissuance is available upon submission of the bank receipt and a statutory declaration of timeliness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board resolution, share allotment, and appointment of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors of the International Company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting by written resolution in accordance with the Articles. The board adopts the registered office and registered agent, approves the allotment of one fully paid ordinary share to the founding member, appoints the director and secretary, and authorizes opening of corporate bank accounts and contractual execution.
required_dossiers: Written board resolution (minutes of first meeting)
Share ledger and register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the resolution is cured by a subsequent ratification resolution passed at a reconvened board meeting within 10 days; the company retains continuity of acts done prior to ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ancillary registrations: business licence and bank account activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Business Licences Division; commercial banks licensed by the Central Bank of Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a General Business Licence covering the conduct of digital content distribution from the registered office, and open a corporate bank account (including USD/APAC settlement accounts for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing proceeds). Provide the certificate of incorporation, board resolution, and due diligence pack to the banking institution.
required_dossiers: Board resolution authorizing bank account opening
Beneficial ownership and KYC declaration pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the business licence application is queried due to incomplete industry classification, re-file under ISIC 9000 (Creative, Arts and Entertainment Activities) with a supporting activity description; if bank onboarding is deferred, submit refreshed directors' registers and source-of-funds declarations to complete enhanced due diligence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Business Licences Division (digital services are subject only to the general business licence regime; no industrial operating permit is separately mandated).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business Licence (Business Licences Act 1998) covering online publishing and digital subscription services; no specialised licence applies to web-novel platforms.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Planning and Urban Management Agency.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – office-based digital service with no construction, land disturbance, or industrial plant; no EIA report or registration required under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to software/data operations; general compliance with municipal waste disposal, small-scale electromagnetic emissions (IT equipment), and electricity consumption efficiency is required where the company leases physical office space.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) for any leased office premises; structural load inspection and building compliance certificate from the Planning and Urban Management Agency for commercial tenancy; occupational safety and health registration and workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2011, administered by the Ministry of Labour.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Mafoe mo Tupe Maua), Government of Samoa — official tax authority and portal: https://www.mfr.gov.ws. The Ministry administers the Income Tax Act 2015, the Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) Act 2014, and excise/stamp duties, and operates the Tax Online e-filing facility. Incorporation of an International Company (IC) is administered separately by the International Companies Office under the Registrar of International Companies within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor incorporates a Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 2017 through a licensed registered agent or Samoan corporate services provider. The Registrar of International Companies issues a Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique IC registration number. Because the IC enjoys a statutory income tax and VAGST exemption, the Ministry for Revenue does not require a separate income tax TIN; the IC registration number is the standard government identifier. If the IC nevertheless makes registrable taxable supplies in Samoa, it must complete Form VAGST-001 through the Tax Online portal, attaching the certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, and an estimate of 12-month Samoa-sourced turnover; a VAGST registration number is then issued within the statutory processing period.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the Samoa IC is a non-resident limited company statutorily exempt from income tax, VAGST, stamp duty, dividend withholding, and national provident fund levies on all offshore business income, assets, and transactions regardless of beneficial ownership; only an annual government fee (based on authorised capital) is payable to the International Companies Office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election, hybrid entity election, or classification opt-in exists under Samoan law. The IC tax-exempt regime is automatic and mandatory for companies incorporated under the International Companies Act 2017 that do not carry on domestic business in Samoa. An IC may voluntarily relinquish its exempt status by filing an election with the Registrar to be converted into a domestic company under the Companies Act 2006, after which it becomes taxable at entity level under the Income Tax Act 2015 on worldwide income. Samoa does not recognise US-style hybrid mismatch elections; the Income Tax Act 2015 contains general anti-avoidance and income-apportionment rules, and no OECD Pillar Two or CFC registration election is available at this stage.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) — administered under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2014 and the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Regulations 1997 (as amended); imports and local supplies of goods and services are within its territorial scope.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 — annual taxable turnover from supplies made in Samoa triggers mandatory VAGST registration, with voluntary registration permitted below the threshold. Offshore digital subscription revenue from non-resident end-users (including collections through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing) is outside Samoan territorial supplies and does not count toward the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not impose real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, SAF-T reporting, or digital stamping/QR e-invoicing. A VAGST-registered person must issue serially numbered VAGST invoices (full invoices above the invoicing threshold and simplified invoices below it), retain records for at least five years, file monthly or bi-monthly VAGST returns through the Ministry for Revenue's Tax Online portal, and submit annual reconciliation schedules. Apple and Google are not treated as Samoan fiscal clearance agents, and no API integration with the Ministry for Revenue is required for the exempt IC at this stage.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For a VAGST-registered Samoan entity, a 0% VAGST rate applies to (i) goods exported within 28 days of supply with documentary proof of export and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of performance where the direct and primary benefit is wholly or substantially offshore, including digital subscription platforms and serialised web-fiction content monetised through app stores. The Samoa IC qualifies as a Tax_Exempt_Zone non-resident entity and is not required to charge VAGST on foreign-consumer sales; conversely, it may not claim input VAT credits unless it voluntarily registers. If the IC elects voluntary registration, it must substantiate each zero-rated supply with platform payout statements and non-resident user evidence to preserve 0% treatment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs Service electronic export declaration) identifying the digital/electronic dispatches as intangible exports
Commercial invoice and sales reconciliation statement for the platform subscription transactions
App Store Connect (Apple IAP) and Google Play Console financial and payout reports evidencing gross revenue and applicable platform commission deductions
Inward Remittance Certificate or corresponding SWIFT/bank credit evidence and platform payout ledger proving offshore funds received in Samoa
Non-resident customer tax-location evidence (IP-address geolocation, billing address, and storefront region settings)
Retained VAGST invoice (if issued) and digital delivery log evidencing offshore supply
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating is sanctioned under the VAGST Act 2014 and the Crimes Act 2013: the Ministry for Revenue may reassess the uncollected 15% VAGST retrospectively, add a late-payment penalty of up to 25% of the outstanding tax plus statutory monthly interest, claw back previously allowed input credits with compound interest, and impose fines up to WST 10,000 with imprisonment not exceeding three years for false invoices or knowingly false export declarations. Directors, beneficial owners, and the licensed registered agent may be jointly assessed under anti-avoidance provisions of the Income Tax Act 2015 if the IC attracts on-island economic substance. For the exempt IC itself, the principal Samoan enforcement risk is loss of exempt status, causing all taxes, penalties, and interest to become due plus deregistration; no export VAT refund is payable to an entity that never collected VAGST.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Falefa Sāmoa) acting as the Foreign Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Central Bank Act 1984
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is convertible for current international trade and service transactions, but capital account movements remain subject to central bank documentation and prior approval requirements. Samoa maintains functional convertibility for dividends, interest, and profit remittances of licensed/offshore activities, provided the repatriation is supported by audited financial statements and tax clearance. International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 and operating wholly outside Samoa are treated as non-resident for exchange control purposes; their foreign-currency bank accounts may be freely credited and debited without WST conversion hurdles. Profit remittances to shareholders are generally permissible through the authorised banking system upon production of the annual return, beneficial ownership register, and board resolution confirming dividend availability.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters of physical goods, export proceeds must be collected within 180 days from date of shipment and surrendered to an authorised dealer in WST at the prevailing market rate; 100% conversion applies unless a specific exemption is granted by the Central Bank. For the International Company generating digital webnovel subscription revenue, no physical export surrender obligation applies; receivables may be held in foreign currency offshore without mandatory conversion. If funds are repatriated to Samoa and converted to WST, the transaction is recorded under the purpose code for software/information technology services and no surrender percentage is prescribed beyond standard current-account conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Samoa currently has no statutory sandbox or dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime. Foreign digital banks, virtual IBAN providers, and non-bank payment service providers cannot obtain a direct clearing membership or a Samoa national clearing code. Such providers may only function through a licensed commercial bank as a supporting payment gateway for Apple IAP and Google Play settlements, but they are not permitted to hold the core corporate treasury account or perform fiduciary settlement. Use of offshore EMIs is permissible only as collection intermediaries that sweep funds daily into the licensed Samoan/offshore bank account; no account-holding or collateral authority may be delegated to the EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandated for at least one authorized signatory (clear CEO or finance director) for the initial account opening. The Central Bank's AML/CFT directives require the responsible officer to verify beneficial ownership identity in person. Remote opening is available only in exceptional circumstances for existing cross-border banking clients, requiring diplomatic or consular notarisation, an apostilled certified copy of the passport, a banks own QC verification supplement, and submission of the original board resolution. The final decision rests with the bank's local compliance committee; no bank is obligated to accept remote opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained provenance of high-frequency digital subscription revenue aggregating through Apple/Google store payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 1) Platform operating licence and content moderation policy; 2) Export monthly consolidated revenue reports by payment rail; 3) Apple/Google payout statements with transaction summaries; 4) Backend server logs showing subscriber growth and average revenue per user; 5) Audited or accountant-reviewed financial statements in English; 6) CRM sample showing legitimate user refunds; 7) Evidence of fair-value exchange rates applied by app stores.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore trust or corporate beneficial owners domiciled in non-FATF-Equivalent jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 1) Registered agent certificate; 2) Beneficial ownership register extracted under the International Companies Act; 3) Trustee confirmation providing the ultimate natural person and percentage interest; 4) LinkedIn/credential scan of the natural person controller; 5) Passport copies of all UBOs and directors; 6) Bank reference letter from the source jurisdiction; 7) Source of wealth statement with asset documentation likely to demonstrate funds supporting the pilot.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The entity has zero physical footprint in Samoa and intends to use only a registered agent for correspondence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 1) Registered office and registered agent agreement with a licensed Samoa trust company; 2) Appointment of a Samoan resident as principal contact person for compliance notices; 3) Detailed board resolution confirming management control remains with non-residents but acknowledging Samoa AML jurisdiction; 4) Statement of non-resident operations and marketing to far-east audiences; 5) Undertaking to produce documents within 5 business days upon CBS or bank request.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of digital assets, virtual tokens, or crypto-related settlement rails within the app's payment flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 1) Board resolution confirming all related revenue passes exclusively through fiat app stores; 2) Technical schema showing no cryptocurrency wallet integration; 3) Apple/Google policy approval confirming no prohibited crypto element; 4) Legal opinion from Samoa counsel defining the absence of a Stored Value Facility or money transmission activity; 5) The company's payment architecture diagram with AML control points at the fiat gateway and sweep bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is wired via SWIFT MT103 from the parent or subscriber investment vehicle to the Samoan licensed bank (or the company's offshore clearing bank if using the non-resident IC credit line). The payment must use purpose code for equity injection (e.g., 'Capital Contribution - ISIC 9000 Digital Content Platform') and be supported by board minutes, share allotment resolution, source of funds declaration, and beneficial ownership schedule. The Samoan bank will record the injection as a non-resident direct investment and will verify that the payer/payee names match the KYC records. For loan capital, an executed facility letter, interest and repayment schedule, and external borrowing approval from the Central Bank (when exceeding exemption thresholds) must be provided. Upon credit confirmation, the funds are immediately available for platform operations without custody restriction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for software licensing, content author royalties, and digital advertising fees is routed through the same licensed bank using SWIFT MT103. For high-value content acquisition (e.g., exclusive Chinese-language novel licensing exceeding USD 50,000), the bank will request either a proforma invoice, governing service agreement, and signed acceptance certificate; a Commercial Letter of Credit is available only for physical goods and is not required for digital services. Merchant disbursements to foreign authors may be batched through the payment gateway provider, but the clearing bank must provide a monthly settlement report for AML reconciliation. To avoid sanctions risk, the company must have a real-time screening filter against OFAC, UN, EU, and Samoa's domestic sanctions lists, and any non-U.S. dollar settlement must be expressly approved by the FX control desk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Commercial FX forwards with a maturity up to 12 months, offered by ANZ Bank (Samoa) Limited and BSP Samoa, for economically hedged USD/WST or CNY/WST exposure arising from subscription revenue and royalty payments.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on the Samoan tālā transacted through a non-resident investment bank to hedge WST volatility without requiring onshore WST delivery.

Cross-currency swaps with a licensed international bank, subject to Central Bank approval, when used for currency transformation of medium-term shareholder debt into operational base currency (USD/CNH).

Plain-vanilla foreign exchange options (put/call on USD-WST) entered under an ISDA with a counterparty that holds a Samoa authorised dealer license or is a recognized Tier-1 global bank, provided each transaction has underlying commercial exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies – Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 100 per month; failure beyond 3 months triggers notice of strike-off and final dissolution after 6 months.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee (Business Franchise Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority / Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 1 July each year (pro-rated for companies incorporated after 1 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% fee surcharge if unpaid after 31 July; 20% after 1 October; automatic strike-off and asset forfeiture after 12 months of non-payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) through registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June each year (calendar-year cycle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of WST 50 per day; potential criminal liability for directors for a continued offence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Any International Company with gross annual revenue exceeding WST 2,000,000 (USD 750,000) or total assets exceeding WST 4,000,000 (USD 1,500,000); a licensed bank, trust, or insurance company; any public company; or a company in which a shareholder holding not less than 10% of the issued shares has requested a statutory audit in accordance with Section 74 of the International Companies Act 2012.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial records must reflect the financial position with reasonable accuracy; IFRS as adopted by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) is the default for any audit conducted. For exempt companies not requiring audit, internal management accounts prepared under IFRS or US GAAP are accepted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On each anniversary of incorporation, the registered agent must obtain from each shareholder a written confirmation of the current beneficial owner; shareholders are also required to file a Form UC (UBO Change) within 14 days of any transfer. The Company must maintain a subsidiary UBO register at the registered office and file a consolidated copy annually with the FIU by 30 June. Failure to confirm automatically suspends the shareholder's right to dividends, voting, and transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 - 3,000 per annum (includes registered address, corporate secretary, document custody, and government compliance coordination)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - 9,000 where a compulsory independent audit is triggered (typically 0.5% - 1.5% of revenue for a digital subscription company)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (Samoa Income Tax Ordinance 2015, resident company rate); 0% for an International Company (IC) licensed under the International Companies Act 1987, which is statutorily exempt from income tax on all foreign-source and offshore business income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IC is an exempt vehicle: 0% corporate income tax; no capital gains tax; no estate, inheritance, or stamp duty on offshore asset transfers; no exchange control restrictions; exempt distributions to shareholders at 0% dividend withholding tax; a tiered annual government fee (approximately USD 250 to USD 2,500 by authorized capital tier) replaces all income tax; no minimum capital requirement; no payroll tax on non-resident staff.
